name: Lienzo UI
description: Lets an agent create and edit Unity interface designs in Lienzo UI, review them, take screenshots and export them to a Unity project. Exporting writes straight into Assets/EditorGUI with no prompt in the editor, so export_unity is reviewed. dry_run lists the changes first. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep export_unity, and its hidden alias exportar_unity, on Review: it writes straight into Assets/EditorGUI of the Unity project and nothing in the editor asks first.
Call export_unity with dry_run: true first. It writes nothing and lists each file as new, update, same or remove; confirm the list, then export for real.
export_unity only touches Assets/EditorGUI (plus the scripts folder you set), refuses network paths and never overwrites C# files that lack the Generated by Lienzo UI first line.
Keep the Unity project under version control so any export can be reviewed and undone.
